class.name: LanguageSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the language: locale, pseudolocalization, layout direction and auto-translate mode.

method.name: get_available_locales
method.description: Returns the locales of the loaded translations (see [method TranslationServer.get_loaded_locales]), sorted and without duplicates. Use [method TranslationServer.get_locale_name] for the names shown in a menu.

method.name: get_command_line_locale
method.description: Returns the locale passed with the command line argument [code]--language[/code] or [code]-l[/code], or an empty string.

method.name: get_layout_direction
method.description: Returns the pending layout direction of the root window.

method.name: get_locale
method.description: Returns the pending locale chosen by the player, or an empty string if the game follows the operating system. The locale that is active now is [method TranslationServer.get_locale]; it differs while a session override is set or when no translation is loaded for the stored locale.

method.name: get_project_locale
method.description: Returns the locale used for an empty [member LanguageSettings.locale]: [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/locale/test] if it is set, otherwise the locale of the operating system ([method OS.get_locale]).

method.name: get_root_auto_translate_mode
method.description: Returns the pending auto-translate mode of the root window.

method.name: is_pseudolocalization_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if pseudolocalization is enabled in the pending settings.

method.name: set_layout_direction
method.description: Sets the layout direction of the root window (see [method Window.set_layout_direction]). [constant Window.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_INHERITED] follows [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/rendering/root_node_layout_direction].

method.name: set_locale
method.description: Sets the locale, for example [code]"fr"[/code] or [code]"pt-BR"[/code]. The locale is standardized (see [method TranslationServer.standardize_locale]), so [code]"pt-BR"[/code] is stored as [code]"pt_BR"[/code]. An empty string follows the operating system. Replaces a session override from the command line or the test locale.

method.name: set_root_auto_translate_mode
method.description: Sets the auto-translate mode of the root window ([member Node.auto_translate_mode]). With [constant Node.AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_DISABLED], nodes that inherit the mode show their texts untranslated.
